description: Create per-artist Instagram post captions that combine show context, AI-generated show bio, AI artist bio, track listing, and social links. Add a new backend endpoint and admin UI to generate/preview/post artist-specific Instagram content from the ArtistDetailPage.

steps.task: Add a new AI prompt and function generate_artist_instagram_caption() in ai.rs that produces a show-context bio (AI_SHOW_ARTIST_BIO). This is a separate prompt from the existing artist bio — it references the show title/number and frames the artist as a guest on that specific show. Accept parameters: artist_name, pronouns, music_description, show_title, track1_name, track2_name.

decisions: Use a separate AI prompt (INSTAGRAM_POST_PROMPT) distinct from the existing SYSTEM_PROMPT which generates short artist bios. The new prompt generates a longer show-context paragraph.

The AI generates only the AI_SHOW_ARTIST_BIO paragraph. The existing ai_bio field provides the AI_ARTIST_BIO paragraph. The rest of the caption (header, tracks, links) is assembled from DB fields — no AI needed.
Extracted shared call_openai() helper to eliminate duplication between generate_artist_bio and generate_artist_instagram_caption
New function uses max_tokens: 400 (vs 200 for short bio) since the show-context paragraph is longer
knowledge.notes: The function should return just the show-context bio text. Caption assembly happens in the handler.

steps.task: Add new API endpoint POST /api/artists/:id/generate-instagram-caption in api.rs. This handler: (1) fetches the artist from DB (name, pronouns, music_description, ai_bio, track1_name, track2_name, instagram, soundcloud), (2) fetches the artist's assigned show(s) via artist_show_assignments to get show.title, (3) calls ai::generate_artist_instagram_caption() for the show-context bio, (4) assembles the full caption using the template format, (5) stores the result in a new instagram_caption field on the artist, (6) returns the caption as JSON.

sub_plan.description: Break the endpoint implementation into data model + handler + routing

steps.task: Add instagram_caption column to artists table in db.rs migration (add_column_if_missing) and add pub instagram_caption: Option<String> to Artist struct in models.rs

decisions: The show is determined by fetching the most recent show assigned to this artist via artist_show_assignments ORDER BY s.date DESC LIMIT 1
Instagram handle is extracted from instagram URL (strip https://instagram.com/ prefix, like post_show_to_instagram already does)
If artist has no ai_bio yet, generate it first using existing generate_artist_bio() before assembling
Soundcloud line is included only if artist has a soundcloud link
Instagram @handle line is included only if artist has an instagram profile

steps.task: Register the route POST /api/artists/:id/generate-instagram-caption in main.rs and add instagram_caption to ArtistDetailResponse in api.rs
Verify backend compiles with cargo check. Fix any compilation errors.
Add instagram_caption field to ArtistDetail interface in admin/api/index.ts. Add generateInstagramCaption API method that calls POST /api/artists/:id/generate-instagram-caption.

Add Instagram Caption section to ArtistDetailPage.vue (view mode). Show the stored instagram_caption in a styled card (similar to the existing ai_bio card). Add a 'Generate Instagram Caption' button (or 'Regenerate' if one exists). Display the caption in a pre-formatted block so line breaks are visible. Add a 'Copy to Clipboard' button next to the caption for easy pasting into Instagram.

decisions: Instagram caption section goes in the view mode (not edit mode) since it's auto-generated, similar to the existing AI bio section
Pre-formatted display uses CSS white-space: pre-wrap to preserve the newlines in the caption
Copy-to-clipboard button uses navigator.clipboard.writeText() with success flash message
knowledge.notes: The caption is read-only in the UI — user generates it, then copies to clipboard for manual posting or uses the existing show-level Instagram post flow.

steps.task: Verify frontend builds with npm run build / tsc --noEmit. Fix any TypeScript errors.
